product.summary: GridPlus Lattice1 hardware wallet using a secure enclave for private-key generation, storage and signing.
product.notes: Current first-party documentation establishes the product and on-device secure-enclave key boundary. Sales status remains unknown in this batch because the reviewed documentation does not itself establish current purchase availability.

events.title: Lattice1 firmware v0.18.3 released
events.description: GridPlus released Lattice1 firmware v0.18.3 with Solana signing improvements, security improvements, bug fixes, and user-requested changes.

evidence.title: Lattice1 Security Features
evidence.notes: First-party security documentation states Lattice1 private keys are generated, stored and used for signing inside a secure enclave on the device.

evidence.title: GridPlus SDK
evidence.notes: Official GridPlus organization repository for the SDK used to integrate with Lattice1; the repository is not archived. This supports continuing integration availability but is not by itself a full hardware support commitment, so promotion should remain conservative.

evidence.title: Lattice1 Firmware v0.18.3 Released
evidence.notes: First-party firmware release announcement documenting ongoing Lattice1 maintenance.
